function: Joint learning of downlink CSI from uplink pilots (CSI-Net) and key features (KF-Net) to recover sum-power-minimizing beamforming in cell-free massive MIMO with fronthaul limits (p. 3).
system: Cell-free massive MIMO (TDD), M=20 single-antenna APs, K=5 single-antenna users, fronthaul 1 bps per AP, band not stated, no RIS (p. 1, p. 4).
method: Model-driven deep learning: CSI-Net and KF-Net, four fully connected layers each, trained jointly and supervised with a global loss including sum power (p. 4).
data_channel: 20,000 Rayleigh-fading channels (zero mean, unit variance) generate the training samples; 1,000 test samples likewise; no standardized or measured channel (p. 4).
test_conditions: Training and 1,000 test samples from the same Rayleigh model; sweeps of target rate (0.8-1.6 bps) and AP count (15-35) (p. 4, p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: optimal SPC-based solution [2] (upper bound) and RZF [16] after the CSI-Net; learned: data-driven network [15] and separately trained CSI-Net and KF-Net [6] (p. 4).
metrics: Sum power in dB versus individual user target rate and number of APs; computational complexity order (p. 4, p. 5).
complexity: Proposed O(Λ^2+KM^2+M^3): NN module O(Λ^2), recovery module O(KM^2+M^3); Table I compares the benchmark solutions (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "We generate 20,000 channel coefficients according to a Rayleigh fading model with zero mean and unit variance"; a custom Rayleigh simulator, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "For all neural networks in our learning approach, we reduce the number of the training samples to 10,000"; no model trained on one scenario, number of APs, or users is tested on another, and test data come from the same Rayleigh model (p. 4).
q3_support: p. 4: "The data-driven learning solution [15]: the beamforming matrix is obtained by a data-driven learning network"; non-learned baselines are the optimal SPC solution [2] and RZF [16], all compared on sum power in Figs. 4 and 5.
q4_support: p. 4: "the overall complexity of the proposed approach is" O(Λ^2+KM^2+M^3), with Table I giving the complexity of the benchmark solutions.
q5_support: p. 4: "Based on the generated channels, we respectively calculate the input and output required for the two networks as training samples"; the data are self-generated, and no code or data link, public dataset, or measurement appears in the letter.
notes: Included as beamforming (area 3): the main metric is the sum power, while channel estimation is learned jointly by the CSI-Net. APs and users have one antenna each, but the 20 APs are precoded jointly by the CPU, so the link is multi-antenna. q3 counts the data-driven network [15] as the earlier learned baseline for the reviewer to confirm; separate learning [6] is the proposed networks trained separately and was not counted. q2 is 0: no test on a configuration absent from training is stated, and the AP-count sweep trains on 10,000 samples (p. 5).
